findings.text: non-blocking: `_same_cited_log` duplicates the arm-to-log matching the module already owns at promotion_evidence.py:1162 and drops its `log_digest` support, while ledger.py:543 accepts an arm that names its log by digest alone; such a second-pair head matches nothing, the gate silently falls back to the default pair, and the inherited-failure refusal this node repairs returns for that shape.

non-blocking: `_require_gate_log_agrees` still reads only `manifest.get("after_suite")`, so a gate on a recorded `suite_pairs` pair never reaches the receipt comparison and its arm's failure_count and failure_ids go unchecked against the cited log.
non-blocking: the docstring states the return as "(base, head, base, head)" where the code returns `(base, head, base_name, head_name)`, so two of the four slots are named as the values they are not.
non-blocking: `_DEFAULT_SUITE_PAIR` restates the tuple already spelled as `_SUITE_ARM_NAMES` at promotion_evidence.py:1624 in the same module, giving one fact two names that can drift apart.
